title: Ether Machine and Dynamix mutually scrap SPAC merger, blame ‘unfavorable market conditions’
summary: Under the Termination Agreement effective April 8, an unnamed "Payor" likely connected to The Ether Machine must pay Dynamix $50 million within 15 days.

title: US government moves bitcoin possibly linked to steroid distribution conspiracy
summary: The U.S. government currently holds roughly 328,000 bitcoins, worth more than $22 billion at current prices, among other crypto assets.

title: AI agents reshaping crypto development, trading and risk, with Cambrian and Ethereum Foundation
summary: Builders and researchers discuss how AI agents are transforming crypto, from development and trading to entirely new financial systems.

title: Bhutan moves another $18 million in bitcoin as tracked holdings continue to shrink: Arkham
summary: Bhutan moved more bitcoin to a new wallet, continuing an outflow streak that has cut its holdings to 3,774 BTC from a peak of 13,000 BTC.

title: Bitcoin rebound faces oil shock, inflation test despite ceasefire relief as macro jitters persist: analysts
summary: Bitcoin trades at a macro crossroads, with derivatives positioning signaling caution despite ceasefire relief, analysts said.

title: TD Cowen cuts Strategy price target to $350, initiates coverage of Sharplink, Strive, Nakamoto and Smarter Web with buy ratings
summary: TD Cowen cut its Strategy price target to $350 on lower bitcoin assumptions while assigning buy ratings to four digital asset treasury firms.

title: StarkWare researcher proposes ‘quantum-safe’ Bitcoin transactions without a soft fork
summary: It may face limited adoption due to higher costs and a complex user experience, with the proposal described as a “last-resort measure.”

title: ‘Think even bigger’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys 34,164 bitcoin for $2.5 billion as total holdings top 800,000 BTC
content: Strategy's total holdings account for more than 3.8% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth around $61 billion.

title: Global crypto funds see $1.4 billion in weekly inflows as bitcoin rebound boosts risk appetite: CoinShares
content: Crypto ETPs drew $1.4 billion in weekly inflows as improved demand from bitcoin's move above $76,000 lifted sentiment, per CoinShares.

title: Coinbase expands USDC borrowing to UK, allowing loans against bitcoin, ether
content: Coinbase's facility allows UK users to borrow up to $5 million in USDC against bitcoin, ether, and cbETH via Morpho on Base.

title: Spot bitcoin ETFs log nearly $1 billion in weekly inflows, highest since mid-January
content: Morgan Stanley's MSBT logged a weekly net inflow of $71 million in the first full trading week since its debut.

title: EasyDNS accepts responsibility for eth.limo hijack, its first social engineering breach in 28 years
content: The incident joins a growing list of crypto front-ends compromised at the DNS layer in recent months, where even decentralized protocols are vulnerable.

title: Kelp DAO’s rsETH bridge apparently exploited for roughly $292 million in LayerZero-based attack
content: Kelp's emergency pauser multisig froze the protocol's core contracts roughly 46 minutes after the successful drain, blocking two follow-up attempts.

title: Alcoa nears deal to sell dormant New York smelter site to Bitcoin miner NYDIG: Bloomberg
content: Oplinger said the transaction should close in the middle part of this year, as the aluminum giant works to offload 10 dormant US smelter sites.

title: Wrapped XRP launches on Solana, enabling broader DeFi access for token holders
content: The move follows Hex Trust saying in December wXRP would become available on Solana, Optimism, Ethereum, and HyperEVM.

title: Bitcoin holds ‘fragile equilibrium’ near $75K as ETF demand cushions crypto market despite Hormuz tensions: analysts
content: Nearly $1 billion in spot bitcoin ETF inflows and rising stablecoin liquidity suggest institutional demand is still stemming pullbacks.

title: UK gas firm downplays bitcoin mining plans after report suggested pivot
content: The firm said it is exploring the potential to deploy bitcoin mining, but remains committed to progressing the site for UK energy security.

title: Tom Lee says ‘crypto winter is much closer to ending’ as Bitmine buys another 101,627 ETH
content: Bitmine bought 101,627 ETH in a week, pushing its treasury to 4.12% of ether's supply as chairman Lee calls crypto winter's end.
